PREDICTION STORAGE IS A RUN, NOT A COLUMN
No score is ever written onto the employee row. Each assessment is a run header plus one score
row per employee carrying the probability, the score, the tier or band, the confidence or factors,
and a JSON snapshot of the exact features that were sent. Past runs stay selectable, so an old
prediction can be audited on what the model was TOLD, not only on what it said.
